camel_example: aliyun cms PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule --region cn-hangzhou --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Name hostName --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Value nginx --GroupRules.1.Category ecs --GroupRules.1.Filters.1.Function contains --GroupRules.1.FilterRelation and --GroupId 123456
description_en: Creates or modifies an application group with dynamic matching rules based on instance names. All instances that match the rules are automatically added to the application group
description_zh: 调用PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule接口创建或修改按照实例名称动态匹配的应用分组，满足匹配规则的所有实例自动添加到该应用分组中
name: PutMonitorGroupDynamicRule

parameters.help_en: The ID of the application group
parameters.name: group_id

fields.help_en:
The type of the Alibaba Cloud service for the dynamic alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

ecs: cloud server (ECS).

rds: relational database.

slb: load balancing
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的云服务类型。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

ecs：云服务器ECS。

rds：关系型数据库。

slb：负载均衡
fields.name: category

fields.help_en:
The logical operator used to combine the conditions of the dynamic alert rule. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:

and: Instances are automatically added to the application group only if they meet all the alert rules.

or: Instances are automatically added to the application group if they meet any of the alert rules
fields.help_zh:
动态报警规则的组合条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：

and：满足所有报警规则的实例才会自动添加到应用分组。

or：满足任意报警规则的实例都会自动添加到应用分组
fields.name: filter_relation

fields.help_en:
The filter condition for instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 3. Valid values:
contains: Contains.
notContains: Does not contain.
startWith: Starts with.
endWith: Ends with
fields.help_zh:
实例的过滤条件。N的取值范围：1~3。取值：
contains：包含。
notContains：不包含。
startWith：前缀。
endWith：后缀
fields.name: function

fields.help_en:
The name of the field used to match instances. Valid values of N: 1 to 3.

Only the hostname is supported, such as hostName
fields.help_zh:
实例匹配的字段名称。N的取值范围：1~3。

目前仅支持主机名，例如：hostName
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The value that meets the alert condition. Valid values of N: 1 to 3
fields.help_zh: 满足报警条件的值。N的取值范围：1~3
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en:
The mode in which the dynamic alert rule is created. Valid values:

true: The rule is created asynchronously.
false (default): The rule is created synchronously
parameters.help_zh:
创建动态报警规则的模式。取值：

true：异步创建。
false（默认值）：同步创建
parameters.name: is_async

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to only precheck the request. Valid values:
true: A precheck is performed and the security group is not associated with the instance. The system checks whether required parameters are specified, the request format is valid, and service limits are met. If the request fails the precheck, an error is returned. If the request passes the precheck, the `DryRunOperation` error code is returned.
false (default): A normal request is sent. If the request passes the precheck, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会为实例绑定安全组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

Code.description_en:
The HTTP status code.

A status code of 200 indicates success

Message.example: The specified resource is not found.

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation was successful. Valid values:

true: The operation was successful.

false: The operation failed
Success.description_zh:
操作是否成功。取值：

true：成功。

false：失败
